paragraphs.text:
In Breasted’s classic, A History of Egypt, a slip of paper is sticking 
out. It marks “page 170,” and on that page phrases are underlined: 
“internal conflicts,” “the fall of the Old Kingdom,” “the triumph 
becomes complete,” “the crocodile god.”
You also notice a word on the slip of paper. In Gliere’s hand 
it reads: “Quattara.”  
Succeed with another Spot Hidden and go to 188; if failed, 
go to 150.
(24, 49)
